titles.english: Offering My Virginity to a Gangster

description:
The story centers on a 26-year-old virgin office worker named Nagisa. She takes a trip with the aim of improving on her shyness, and has a chance meeting with a yakuza member named Sazanami. She begins a relationship with him after they stay together for one night.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: The first episode will be distributed in advance on March 2023. Regular broadcast will begin on April 2nd, 2023.
